name: io.github.RdyGaming/hated-wow-mcp
title: Hated WoW MCP
description: MCP server for WoW addons: Lua API, Blizzard UI source, CVars, art lookup, linting, scaffolding.

environmentVariables.name: WOW_DEFAULT_FLAVOR
environmentVariables.description: Client to answer for when a tool call does not name one.

environmentVariables.name: WOW_INSTALL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Your World of Warcraft folder. Auto-detected in the standard locations if unset.

environmentVariables.name: WOW_ADDON_PATH
environmentVariables.description: AddOns folder the addon tools read and write. Confines them to that directory.

environmentVariables.name: WOW_MCP_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where synced UI source and game data are stored. Defaults to the OS cache directory.
